scenes.shot: Final public mission-control overview. DEVNET VERIFIED, healthy status, mandate, remaining budget, Devnet, and kill switch must all be readable.
scenes.caption: 이미 완료된 demo5를 증거에서 재생합니다 · 새 결제 없음
scenes.narration: 이 영상은 finalist-demo-5의 해시 고정 리드 온리 리플레이입니다. 새 결제나 재시도는 발생하지 않습니다.

scenes.shot: Mandate panel showing 0.05 incident cap, 0.02 per-transaction cap, ten minutes, USDC/Devnet, capability, and recipient allowlist.
scenes.caption: incident 0.05 USDC · per-tx 0.02 USDC · 10분
scenes.narration: 운영자는 incident 0.05 USDC와 건별 0.02 USDC 한도를 한 번 설정했습니다. 이후 결제 승인은 없습니다.

scenes.shot: Evidence drawer or timeline view with runBindingHash and the stored sequence beginning at sanitized incident/A2A/Gemini. No trigger button interaction.
scenes.caption: incident · mandate · operation · payment · nonce · idempotency
scenes.narration: 저장된 run binding은 incident, mandate, operation, payment, nonce와 idempotency key를 함께 묶습니다. 화면은 이미 완료된 실행을 다시 보여 줍니다.

scenes.shot: Offer comparison and Gemini evidence view showing both immutable offer IDs, live gemini-2.5-flash, baseline standard selection, and counterfactual emergency selection.
scenes.caption: degraded → standard 15000 · full outage → emergency 25000
scenes.narration: Allowlist telemetry만 Gemini 2.5 Flash에 전달됐습니다. Degraded 상황은 standard offer를, full outage counterfactual은 emergency offer를 선택했습니다.

scenes.shot: Chronological protocol timeline with 402, reserve, automatic PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, paid retry, facilitator settle, and confirmed 200. Show header names/hashes, never raw payload bytes.
scenes.callout: STANDARD x402 · EXECUTOR NEVER BROADCASTS FIRST
scenes.caption: 402 → reserve → sign → paid retry → settle → confirmed 200
scenes.narration: Vendor의 402 뒤 private executor가 policy를 다시 읽고 예약했습니다. 먼저 broadcast하지 않고 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE를 만들었고, settle 뒤에만 200을 반환했습니다.

scenes.shot: Evidence drawer with full Explorer link/signature, finalized slot 480903755, Devnet USDC mint, distinct owners and token accounts, and exact negative/positive deltas.
scenes.caption: 0.015 USDC · payer -15000 · payee +15000 · slot 480903755
scenes.narration: 독립 RPC가 Devnet USDC 0.015 결제를 finalized로 확인했습니다. 서로 다른 payer와 payee의 token account가 정확히 15,000씩 감소하고 증가했습니다. Explorer도 같은 transaction을 가리킵니다.

scenes.shot: Verified vendor receipt and separate outcome panel with key IDs, receipt/request/tx/response binding, health probe, statusBefore degraded, and statusAfter healthy.
scenes.caption: vendor receipt → paid resource applied → health probe → healthy
scenes.narration: Vendor receipt는 offer, request, transaction과 response를 묶습니다. 별도 control-plane outcome key가 receipt와 health probe를 묶고 dependency가 healthy로 전환됐음을 증명합니다.

scenes.shot: Both automatic denial rows together: amount.per_transaction_limit 25000 > 20000 and identifier.nonce_fresh, each transactionCreated false and txSignature null.
scenes.caption: over-cap false/null · nonce replay false/null · 추가 거래 0
scenes.narration: 25,000 unit 한도 초과와 기존 nonce 재사용은 signer 전에 자동 거절됐습니다. 두 건 모두 transactionCreated false, txSignature null입니다.

scenes.shot: Final architecture or evidence panel showing three distinct Cloud Run identities, private executor 403, Firestore atomic state, and executor-only signer-secret access. No terminal or IAM token.
scenes.callout: THREE CLOUD RUN IDENTITIES · PRIVATE EXECUTOR
scenes.caption: control plane · payment executor · vendor agent · Firestore
scenes.narration: Control plane, private executor와 vendor는 서로 다른 Cloud Run identity입니다. Firestore가 atomic state를 관리하고 executor만 signer secret을 읽습니다.

scenes.shot: Clean full-screen final mission-control view with healthy state, 0.015 USDC spend, 0.035 remaining, DEVNET VERIFIED, and the Explorer affordance.
scenes.caption: One mandate · zero approval clicks · one verifiable recovery
scenes.narration: 한 번의 mandate, 건별 승인 없는 결제와 복구, 그리고 자동 거절. Uptime402. An outage does not wait for procurement.
